findings.title: Onboarding mutations bypass tenant RBAC
findings.recommendation: Restrict onboarding mutations to client administrators or enforce explicit settings, agents and contacts permissions.

findings.title: GET request mutates onboarding state
findings.recommendation: Move restart to an authenticated, CSRF-protected POST endpoint and require administrator authorization.

findings.title: Known vulnerabilities limited to development dependencies
findings.recommendation: Migrate the Tailwind/ESLint toolchain and omit dev dependencies from runtime images.
